output.review_comment: Pull request lacks a description and contains changes that appear test-specific rather than docstring-aligned. Specifically: (1) The boolean conversion to "true"/"false" strings feels arbitrary without docstring confirmation; (2) Key sorting isn't documented as a requirement; (3) The switch from quote_plus to quote is significant and unexplained. The teammate explicitly stated "docstrings are the source of truth" - these changes need to be justified against the actual docstring. Please provide a PR description explaining how each change aligns with documented behavior and verify all changes are necessary.
